title: Recovery verifier record
description: The server-side record that identifies a session without storing the recovery code.

anon_id.description: Session identifier. Not a secret by itself, but a bearer credential in practice.

code_hash.description: Unpadded base64url of the 32-byte PBKDF2-SHA256 verifier.

code_version.description: 2 = sealed (verifier only). 1 = legacy plaintext row during migration.

sealed_at.description: When the plaintext code was removed.

code.description: Legacy plaintext only. MUST be null after sealing.
